description: This is a unit test class for the DeletePolicy component, testing its immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling for invalid inputs.

classes.name: DeletePolicyTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the DeletePolicy class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the DeletePolicy class and PolicyId are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeletePolicy with null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeletePolicy with null string PolicyId throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Checks that an invalid PolicyId string leads to PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the JSON serialization of DeletePolicy produces the expected output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of DeletePolicy from JSON string and verifies correct property parsing.
